title: Limit of charging seems to be set only for one battery even in laptop there are multiple
line: On laptops with two batteries, Advanced Power Settings now has a Battery selector so each battery gets its own charge limit.
explanation: The charge limit settings in Advanced Power Settings had one pair of spin boxes: the helper reported the lowest stop threshold of all batteries and, on Apply, wrote the same start and stop values to every battery. On a laptop with an internal and a removable battery, the second battery's limits were never shown and were silently overwritten. Now the helper also reports each battery's thresholds and accepts limits per battery; the page shows a Battery selector (only with two or more batteries) above the spin boxes, like the device selector in the Mouse settings, and Apply writes each battery's own limits in a single authenticated call.

commits.message:
kcm: let each battery have its own charge limit

On laptops with two batteries, the charge limit settings showed only one
battery's values, and applying them overwrote the other battery as well.
A Battery selector now shows and applies each battery's own limits.

BUG: 430964

media.caption: Master, fake BAT0 at 40-80% and BAT1 at 70-90%: only one pair of values (BAT0's) is shown.
Master after raising the limit to 85% and applying: both batteries were set to 40-85%, BAT1's own 70-90% is lost.
With the fix: a Battery selector; Battery 2 shows its own 70-90%.
Battery 1 lowered to 75% and Battery 2 raised to 95%, one Apply: BAT0 is now 40-75% and BAT1 70-95%.
